ModMetaData.name: Vanilla Factions Expanded - Deserters: Recruit As Assassination
ModMetaData.author: Kuwah
ModMetaData.description:
Allows assassination targets from Vanilla Factions Expanded - Deserters to be recruited as colonists while still counting as a successful assassination, granting all mission rewards and progressing the deserter plotline.
Features: - Successfully recruiting an assassination target completes the plot mission with Success. - All rewards and Deserter Network progression are awarded automatically. - Safely captures targets without failing the mission when leaving the site in player custody. - Configurable in Mod Options (e.g. Option to also count enslavement). - Safe to add to existing saves.
